reported.scope: Externally published RFI population, not 63 uniquely joined raw observations
reported.claim: TF/SF central interferers are explicitly reported at the indicated exact frequencies, but membership of other signals requires raw join.

archive_selection.scope: Freeze matching exact ON timestamp multi-band files, then nearest OFF calibrator before/after (at most two, same backend; valid headers and distinct pointing), before power access. Never use later target selection based on signal.

admission.rule: For exact published central interferer only: matching frozen ON and at least one distinct OFF pointing, zero drift fixed frequency within 4 Hz; one unique strongest isolated spectral peak (reject competing local maxima), median robust track sigma >=6, occupancy >3 >=0.75 on both. Check raw hash, header, scan, publication and distinct tile; no automatic shape/approximate companion admission. Measure full available rows, store externally labelled evidence wrapper alongside existing immutable UNKNOWN-format raw passport, do not change original G4 or legacy single-anchor validator.
admission.scope: An externally documented central interferer occurrence, not blanket membership of its lookalikes. Multiple scans of one family not independent families; no proof of source hardware origin. Distinct occurrence groups and source date recorded.
admission.output: R33 separate quarantine verified-occurrence candidates, with machine-checked evidence. Any promotion into verified retrieval index requires separate review; no classifier, no veto.

supplement_scouter.method: Download official supplement and hash full bytes; enumerate pages with table/figure captions and machine-readable frequency strings; no OCR or automatic labels. Unreadable plots or absent exact table remain BLOCKED.
